unit.title: Shapes and Symmetry
unit.blurb: Sides and vertices of 2D shapes, faces of 3D shapes, and lines of symmetry.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Describe 2D shapes by their sides and vertices.

O2.t: Recognise 3D shapes and find lines of symmetry.

p: A **vertex** is a corner where two sides meet. A **pentagon** has 5 sides and 5 vertices. A **hexagon** has 6. An **octagon** has 8.
Put your finger on one side and count round until you are back where you started.

p: A **face** is a flat surface. A **cube** has 6 square faces. A **cuboid** has 6 faces. A **cylinder** has 2 flat circle faces and a curved surface. A **sphere** has no flat faces.
A shape is **symmetrical** if a line splits it into two halves that match like a mirror. A butterfly is symmetrical.
